question: 3号教室昨天的平均温度是多少
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.temperature),2) AS avg_temperature FROM sensor_data d JOIN device dv ON d.device_id = dv.id JOIN site s ON dv.site_id = s.id WHERE s.name = '3号教室' AND date(d.ts) = date('now','-1 day')
note: 单表指标 + 时间条件

question: 列出最近一周 CO2 超过 1000 的所有时段
expected_sql: SELECT d.ts, s.name AS site_name, d.co2 FROM sensor_data d JOIN device dv ON d.device_id = dv.id JOIN site s ON dv.site_id = s.id WHERE d.co2 > 1000 AND d.ts >= datetime('now','-7 day') ORDER BY d.ts DESC LIMIT 50
note: 条件筛选 + 时间范围

question: 各教室本月的 CO2 均值排名
expected_sql: SELECT s.name AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(d.co2),2) AS avg_co2 FROM sensor_data d JOIN device dv ON d.device_id = dv.id JOIN site s ON dv.site_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY avg_co2 DESC

question: 报警次数最多的设备属于哪个楼层
expected_sql: SELECT s.floor, s.name AS site_name, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM alarm a JOIN device dv ON a.device_id = dv.id JOIN site s ON dv.site_id = s.id GROUP BY dv.id ORDER BY alarm_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: 5号设备最近三天的湿度均值
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(humidity),2) AS avg_humidity FROM sensor_data WHERE device_id = 5 AND ts >= datetime('now','-3 day')

question: 今天各教室的最高温度
expected_sql: SELECT s.name AS site_name, ROUND(MAX(d.temperature),2) AS max_temperature FROM sensor_data d JOIN device dv ON d.device_id = dv.id JOIN site s ON dv.site_id = s.id WHERE date(d.ts) = date('now') GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY s.name

question: 哪个教室的 CO2 均值最高
expected_sql: SELECT s.name AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(d.co2),2) AS avg_co2 FROM sensor_data d JOIN device dv ON d.device_id = dv.id JOIN site s ON dv.site_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY avg_co2 DESC

question: 按小时统计今天的 CO2 变化
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00', d.ts) AS hour, ROUND(AVG(d.co2),2) AS avg_co2 FROM sensor_data d JOIN device dv ON d.device_id = dv.id JOIN site s ON dv.site_id = s.id WHERE d.ts >= datetime('now','-1 day') GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

question: 温度高于全局均值的记录有多少条
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sensor_data WHERE temperature > (SELECT AVG(temperature) FROM sensor_data)
